newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ROSENBORG SNEAK LATE WINNER OVER MTK BUDAPEST.
newsitem.headline: ROSENBORG SNEAK LATE WINNER OVER MTK BUDAPEST.

text.p: A goal two minutes from time by Sigurd Rushfeldt gave Rosenborg Trondheim of Norway a 1-0 win over MTK Budapest of Hungary in their Champions' League preliminary round first leg match in Budapest on Thursday.
Rushfeldt headed in a corner from Runar Berg from close range to sneak a victory for the Norwegians.
MTK Budapest had the better of the game but visible tired in the last 20 minutes.
Rosenborg had a goal disallowed in the 70th minute when the impressive Mini Jakobsen was adjudged to have handled before he shot past MTK keeper Gabor Babos.
The game was replayed after Wednesday's encounter had been abandoned on 66 minutes following a floodlight failure. MTK were leading 3-2 at the time.
